profile.summary: dgalvez is a mid-level JavaScript developer specializing in jQuery's legacy frontend implementation. Their contributions focus on fixing DOM manipulation issues, improving cross-browser compatibility (particularly for IE9), and enhancing test resilience in jQuery's core. While their expertise is deeply rooted in jQuery and legacy JavaScript environments, their work demonstrates strong debugging skills and attention to detail in maintaining reliable browser behavior. No evidence of modern JavaScript frameworks or backend development is present in their contributions.

Implemented wrapMap.param for <param> element parsing in jQuery (PR 2)
Replaced hardcoded styleSheets number with dynamic document.styleSheets.length (PR 3)
Debugged and fixed Unspecified Error in IE9's focus() method (PR 4)
Referenced JSFiddle test case to verify offsetParent fix (PR 1 description)
Made tests more resilient to browser plugin modifications (PR 3)
Addressed IE9-specific quirks in core jQuery methods (multiple PRs)
Optimized core jQuery methods by avoiding hardcoded values in tests
